result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Licensee may terminate on 30 days’ written notice, receives a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, and Licensor has no convenience-termination right during the Initial Period or extensions. However, it goes beyond the playbook by permitting partial termination and stating that termination is without “further liability,” which could unintentionally waive accrued payment obligations or other liabilities. Partial termination also lacks mechanics for adjusting scope and fees. Those additions are unnecessary and risk changing unrelated commercial intent.
